text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Mejiro Dober is training in her
signature
racewear to get a feel for what
it'll be like in a
real race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Could I take a break? I can't seem to run
well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes aren't on me as she says that.
Instead...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That racewear... She must be a Mejiro. It
looks
like her game's off today.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was just her first lap. Let's see
how
things go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems bothered by the presence of
other
trainers watching her run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All I said is that I wanted to take a
break!
choice_data_list: 今日はトレーニングやめとく？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We don't have to go that far... It's just,
I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I hate this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to stress her out more, but
my
suggestion ends up doing just that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to stress her out more, but
my
suggestion ends up doing just that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, I wonder if her
previous trainer
would have been able to
sympathize with her
more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Mejiro Dober and search all
over the
academy before finally finding
her.
choice_data_list: （いや、落ち込んでいる場合じゃない！）
choice_data_list_en: (No, this is no time to be feeling down!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I told you I was fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you apologizing for?
choice_data_list: ごめん。どうしても心配で……
choice_data_list_en: Sorry. I was just so worried...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The colors of this racewear are the
traditional
colors of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I settled on this design because I want to
be able
to run like the others too... like
a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But... when I think of people seeing me
run as a
member of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't run with the same dominance and
elegance
that McQueen shows...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nor can I meet people's expectations as

confidently and cheerfully as Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They're leaps and bounds ahead of me,
and so
long as I'm wearing this, I'll
always be compared
to them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried that my running will bring
shame to
the Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How could you? Don't just say whatever
to try
and console me!
choice_data_list_en: I understand. I feel the same way.
I understand. I feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: 偉大な先輩にはかなわないって意味でね
choice_data_list_en: Meaning no one can match a great senior, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh...
choice_data_list: 偉大な先輩にはかなわないって意味でね
choice_data_list_en: Meaning no one can match a great senior, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're struggling with the same
thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you aren't backing down from
it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Then I won't either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...And how could I, after seeing how hard
you
work?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing good will come from running
away.
Besides, it would be irritating if I
lost to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. I won't give up. We can do this,
together.
choice_data_list: いきなり無理する必要はない
choice_data_list_en: There's no need to push yourself right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out with that chipper attitude!
Ugh!
choice_data_list: いきなり無理する必要はない
choice_data_list_en: There's no need to push yourself right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to shout... I-it's
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, Dober, it's you! I couldn't help but
come
over when I saw the Mejiro colors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, Dober, it's you! I couldn't help but
come
over when I saw the Mejiro colors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training are you doing
today?
Something tells me this is no
ordinary session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I'm trying to replicate what a real
race will
feel like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that would explain the racewear,
and why
something felt different about
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To don those colors is to shoulder the
Mejiro
name. May I have the pleasure of
testing your
readiness for such a
responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You mean you want to race me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Only if you would allow it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll show you that I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them have a spectacular run,
and
training goes well after that. The
sight of them
gets spectators cheering
from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I have to try...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I have to try...
choice_data_list: 挑戦はどこでもできる

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Anywhere?
choice_data_list: 挑戦はどこでもできる

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's true... But where?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Lifting weights in racewear doesn't
exactly feel
like an action befitting the
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Lifting weights in racewear doesn't
exactly feel
like an action befitting the
Mejiro name.
Lifting in racewear? I love it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for coming in out of nowhere. I was
doing
some bench presses when I heard
your voice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious about what I just said, by the
way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter where you do it, just trying
your best
to get stronger is what the
Mejiro name's all
about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... Th-thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're welcome! All right! Time for
me to get
back to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ryan. And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I suppose I'm grateful for you too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always cheering me on,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober gets in a good workout
while
wearing her signature racewear.

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober gets in a good workout
while
wearing her signature racewear.
